relations.statement: If pi(h1)=pi(h2) and sigma(h1)!=sigma(h2), then no auditor A factoring through pi satisfies A(pi(h))=sigma(h) for all h.
relations.hypotheses: pi and sigma are functions on a type H of histories; A is a function on the codomain of pi.

relations.statement: On a finite declared population, if sigma is constant on each fiber of a summary map s, then sigma factors through s.
relations.hypotheses: H is finite and declared; s: H -> T; for all h1,h2, s(h1)=s(h2) implies sigma(h1)=sigma(h2).

lemmas.statement: If pi(h1)=pi(h2) and sigma(h1)!=sigma(h2), there is no A with forall h, A(pi h)=sigma h.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem no_blind_auditor {H V S : Type} (sigma : H -> S) (pi : H -> V) (h1 h2 : H) (hp : pi h1 = pi h2) (hs : sigma h1 != sigma h2) : Not (Exists fun A : V -> S => forall h, A (pi h) = sigma h) := by
  rintro ⟨A, hA⟩
  apply hs
  rw [← hA h1, ← hA h2, hp]

lemmas.statement: If sigma is constant on fibers of a summary s, there exists f with sigma = f composed with s.
lemmas.lean_skeleton:
theorem summary_factors {H T S : Type} (sigma : H -> S) (s : H -> T) (hc : forall a b, s a = s b -> sigma a = sigma b) [Nonempty S] : Exists fun f : T -> S => forall h, f (s h) = sigma h := by
  sorry

near_misses.rejecting_invariant: A summary on which sigma is constant per fiber of the view suffices; raw retention is a provenance policy.
